commander: Meyer (rank and first name not given in the sources used)
composing_units: reinforced 915th Grenadier Regiment (352nd Division); its 2nd Bn was split off at midday and attached to the 916th Regiment
current_activity: advancing to assemble for a counterattack toward Crépon; British already in the area
engaged_with: British forces (Gold Beach sector; unit not named by CMH)
notes: NEW in v5. LXXXIV Corps reserve (reinforced 915th Regiment) ordered to attack toward Crépon against the British penetration near Meuvaines; the main body reached its Bazenville-Villiers-le-Sec assembly area about 17:30 and found the British already in possession. Its 2nd Bn went to the 352nd centre and met firm American resistance near Colleville. Coordinates are the village centre of Bazenville (not source-geocoded for the KG). CMH ch. VIII.
